title: F-GC21P1-R1 Exact Accepted Bottom Interface Exchange Result Independent Qualification
qualified_behavior: Rejected full-trial interface exchange is excluded from accepted two-half result.
Rejected retry attempts do not leak interface exchange into the accepted result.
Accepted two-half exchange is the sum of accepted half exchanges and terminal flux is from the accepted terminal half.
Model-certificate acceptance exposes only the accepted candidate exchange.
Missing and nonfinite interface exchange fail closed to unavailable/zero publication.
Canonical interval exchange aggregates only accepted substeps and publishes only after the full requested interval completes.
Substep-limit failure does not publish partial exchange and does not mutate external committed state.
Generic non-calendar time windows are supported by the tested contract.
R1 equality predicates match the restart canonical exactly; warning hygiene no longer changes production semantics.
O0/O2 outputs are identical for the independent adversarial suite.
next_required_gate: A separate canonical-integration workunit must recheck the then-current integration/f-ci-canonical, compose the exact qualified source postimage, preserve F-VQ63 evidence and execute broad postpromotion preservation before any canonical-admission claim.
closeout_rule: This status deliberately does not self-reference its containing commit. The workflow is configured to rerun on this metadata path; the exact final branch head is authority only after that run is green and no production-source delta exists relative to the owner authority.
